title: WaiComputer
tagline: First wearable crypto-enabled necklace with AI. So simple that your granny could use it, so stylish that you can wear it on fashion week
description:
WaiComputer - ai-enabled web3 necklace, which one so easy to use, that even my granny could send me a crypto now! And so cute, that my girlfriend could wear it on the fashion week.

The project is a necklace with ai-chip integrated - so user could ask to transfer funds, create new coin, ask an advice - all using voice. And after completing the operation receive an answer in a messenger.

The possibility are endless:
- funds management
- investment - not only advice, but your personal investment agent
- new coins deployment: super easy using your voice 
- summarisation of the meetings
- advices from the famous people what to improve in your day (your personal ai-driven advicsory board, that know privately  all about your day and could give useful advices)
how_its_made:
- I am using seeed studio nrf52840 sense ai-enabled chip, which i've soldered with the battery and put in the case (all during the hackathon)
Then i've integrated coinbase programmable wallet agent and llm to categorize request
Also i have added xmtp messenger to obtain responses from the necklace
